description: Shared model utilities and configuration management functions for the openclaw project, including config loading, model resolution, and alias handling.

methods.name: ensureFlagCompatibility
methods.description: Checks for incompatible command-line flags --json and --plain.

methods.name: formatTokenK
methods.description: Formats a number as a token count string, e.g., '512' or '1k'.

methods.name: formatMs
methods.description: Formats a number as a milliseconds or seconds string.

methods.name: isLocalBaseUrl
methods.description: Determines if a URL is local (localhost, 127.0.0.1, etc.).

methods.name: loadValidConfigOrThrow
methods.description: Loads the current configuration, throws if invalid.

methods.name: updateConfig
methods.description: Reads, mutates, and writes back the configuration.

methods.name: resolveModelTarget
methods.description: Resolves a model reference string to a provider and model.

methods.name: resolveModelKeysFromEntries
methods.description: Resolves multiple model reference strings to model keys.

methods.name: buildAllowlistSet
methods.description: Builds a set of allowed model keys from config.

methods.name: normalizeAlias
methods.description: Normalizes and validates an alias string.

methods.name: resolveKnownAgentId
methods.description: Resolves and validates an agent ID.

methods.name: upsertCanonicalModelConfigEntry
methods.description: Ensures a model entry exists in the models record, handling legacy keys.

methods.name: mergePrimaryFallbackConfig
methods.description: Merges primary and fallback settings into a config object.

methods.name: applyDefaultModelPrimaryUpdate
methods.description: Updates the configuration with a new primary model or imageModel.
